kebab_example: aliyun polardb update-knowledge-space --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --knowledge-space-id pks-xxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateKnowledgeSpace

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the knowledge space
parameters.name: knowledge_space_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the knowledge space. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 知识空间名称（1-128 字符）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the knowledge space. The description can be up to 512 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 知识空间备注（最多 512 字符）
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The name of the reranking model
parameters.name: rerank_model

parameters.help_en: The name of the large language model
parameters.name: llm_model

fields.help_en: The maximum number of tokens per chunk. The value must be a positive integer
fields.help_zh: 单个分片的最大 Token 数量，必须为正整数
fields.name: max_tokens

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to merge adjacent small chunks under the same heading
fields.help_zh: 是否合并同一标题下相邻的小分片
fields.name: merge_peers

fields.help_en: The parameters of the default chunking strategy. MaxTokens and MergePeers take effect only when Type is set to hybrid
fields.help_zh: 默认分块策略参数。MaxTokens 和 MergePeers 仅在 Type=hybrid 时生效
fields.name: parameters

fields.help_en: The type of the default chunking strategy. Valid values: hybrid or hierarchical
fields.help_zh: 默认分块策略类型。取值：hybrid 或 hierarchical
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The default chunking strategy. This strategy is used when no rule is matched
fields.help_zh: 默认分块策略。没有规则命中时使用该策略
fields.name: default_strategy

fields.help_en: The content type. Currently, only table is supported
fields.help_zh: 内容类型。当前仅支持 table
fields.name: content_type

fields.help_en: The match condition of the rule. Currently, only exact matching of table content by content type is supported
fields.help_zh: 规则匹配条件。当前仅支持按内容类型等值匹配表格内容
fields.name: match

fields.help_en: The processing mode for Markdown tables. Valid values: auto, on, or off
fields.help_zh: Markdown 表格处理模式。取值：auto、on 或 off
fields.name: markdown_tables

fields.help_en: The maximum number of tokens per chunk for matched content. The value must be a positive integer
fields.help_zh: 命中内容的单个分片最大 Token 数量，必须为正整数
fields.name: max_tokens

fields.help_en: The chunking strategy parameters for the override rule. MaxTokens takes effect only when Type is set to hybrid. MarkdownTables supports auto, on, or off
fields.help_zh: 覆盖规则的分块策略参数。MaxTokens 仅在 Type=hybrid 时生效；MarkdownTables 支持 auto、on 或 off
fields.name: parameters

fields.help_en: The type of the chunking strategy to use when the rule is matched. Valid values: hybrid or hierarchical
fields.help_zh: 规则命中后的分块策略类型。取值：hybrid 或 hierarchical
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The chunking strategy to use when the rule is matched
fields.help_zh: 匹配成功后使用的分块策略
fields.name: strategy

fields.help_en: The list of override rules that are matched in order. Currently, a maximum of one exact-match rule with ContentType set to table is supported
fields.help_zh: 按顺序匹配的覆盖规则列表。当前最多支持一条 ContentType=table 的等值匹配规则
fields.name: rules

parameters.help_en: The default chunking strategy configuration for the knowledge space. Both simple strategies and composite strategies that match by content type are supported
parameters.help_zh: 知识空间默认分块策略配置。支持简单策略和按内容类型匹配的复合策略
parameters.name: sharding_strategy_config

KnowledgeSpaceId.description_en: The unique identifier of the knowledge space

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous workflow task. This value is empty if no actual model change occurs
TaskId.description_zh: 异步工作流任务ID。没有实际模型变化时为空
TaskId.title_en: 异步工作流任务ID。没有实际模型变化时为空。
TaskId.title_zh: 异步工作流任务ID。没有实际模型变化时为空。
